title: Hagati y'Isi n'Ijuru
intro: Umutima w’akabanga urakurindiriye mu mapaji meranda y’amateka y’Imana, utwaye ibimenyetso n’ibitangaza biguma bivuga mu bihe vyose. Uko ukurikira inzira y’ibimenyetso, uzoca mu nkuru irangwa n’ibitangaro — kuva ku ntango y’igitangaza gushika ku kuduga hirya y’ikirere. Woba ushobora kumenya uwo musuku ahezagiwe imbere y’ikimenyetso ca nyuma?
clues: Narungitswe nk’intumwa ku bene Isirayeli n’inkuru y’ikigongwe n’umuco.
Ivuka ryanje ryari ikimenyetso c’igitangaza — naje muri iyi si nta se mfise, ku itegeko ry’Ishobora vyose.
Navuze nkiri uruyoya, ndwanira icubahiro ca mawe ku birego vy’abantu biwe.
Ku ruhusha rwa Allah, narabumvye inyoni n’ibumba ndazihumekeramwo ubuzima — ziguruka zigenda imbere y’amaso y’abazibona.
Narakiza abavutse ari impumyi, ndakiza ababembe, mbere ndazura n’abapfuye — yamara igitangaza cose cari ku ruhusha rwa Allah, si rwanje.
Igihe abansi banje bagira umugambi wo kuntikiza, Allah yaramdugije mw’ijuru, ansezeranya ko nzogaruka imbere y’umusi w’urubanza.

outcome.label: Ivyo vyabaye kuri jewe
options: Yarahawe ubutunzi bwo kw’isi butagira uko bungana .
Nasubiye kubonana n'umuryango wanje inyuma y'igihe kirekire dutandukanye

arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verse: He [i.e., Jesus] was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel. (43:59)
